div.div: حَذِيرٌ [A cautioner]. You say, أَنَا حَذِيرُكَ مِنْهُ i. e. مُحَذِّرُكَ [I am thy cautioner against him, or it]; (TA;) or أُحَذِّرُكَهُ [I caution thee against him, or it]: (K:) known to As as heard only from Lth. (TA.) [See also what next follows.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
